messages:
sam: Quick idea drop— follow-up on reducing trace ingestion cost: introduce compact envelopes + on-demand rehydration. Thoughts?

anya: short Q: what's in the compact envelope vs full trace?

sam: compact: route_id, span_count, billing_hash, tenant_hint, small provenance token, attribute_bitmap. Full trace keeps all spans, attrs, logs. Compact is ~1-2% size.

kevin: how does rehydration work? on-query or background?

sam: Two modes: (1) on-query: if a user runs a precise query we attempt rehydrate from cold store + provenance token (adds latency), (2) scheduled rehydrate: for routes with high re-run rate we keep a short window of full traces. Rehydrate flow: user query -> enrichment service checks provenance token -> materialize spans -> respond.

mira: ops & billing concern: if we drop original billing_key and only keep billing_hash, joins will be probabilistic. need confidence and explainability.

sam: agreed. We'll attach "attr_confidence" per aggregation. Also keep deterministic mapping for enterprise customers (allow opt-in to keep full billing keys).

anya: rollout? feature flags by org/route? Canary thresholds?

sam: plan: route-level flag with 0/1/percent. Canary on 0.5% routes gives signals: cost_per_unit, rehydrate_latency_p95, attribution_conflict_rate. Auto-adjust if attribution_conflict_rate > 0.01. CLI toggle: POST /flags/adaptive_compact?routes_pct=0.5

kevin: testing: we should run an offline sim and a dry-run pass that marks traces but still ingests full payloads to validate deltas.

sam: yes—ana will run dry-run. Output: per-route estimated-cost-savings, estimated-attr-error, sample of rehydrate latencies.

mira: console UX: expose "attr_confidence" and a link to request raw reconstitution. Also show a note if route is in compact mode.

obs-bot: Created task OBS-1310: "compact-envelope + rehydration follow-up" with subtasks: schema, dry-run, console-mock, rollout-playbook.

kevin: one more edge case: downstream alerting that relied on full spans (e.g., latency histograms) will degrade. need migration strategy for alerts.

sam: migration: provide shim metrics (approx histograms from compact) and a migration checklist for teams to opt their critical alerts to preserved sampling.

anya: sounds good. next steps?

sam: I'll update RFC with schema and rehydrate API. anya will own dry-run sim. kevin will draft rollback automation. mira will mock Console changes. Ping on thread for syncs.

mira: added to Thu obs-arch agenda.

anya: thanks all—short and action-oriented.
